angles.title: public-shape consistency across list vs single-item reads

droppedAngles.title: migrations-and-rollout
droppedAngles.why: No migration file is touched by this diff. Migration 003 (backfilling interestRateBps to 0) and the SCHEMA entry for it were added in a prior commit (7fc1c3c), not this PR. The serializer's `a.interestRateBps ?? 0` already covers any row that predates that migration, so there is no new schema change, no new column drop, and no new deploy-order hazard introduced here.

droppedAngles.title: authz-and-attribution
droppedAngles.why: No route, guard, or identity-derivation logic changes. GET /accounts/:id still runs through requireUser + getOwnAccount (ownerId === user.id check, unchanged); POST .../interest-rate still runs through requireRole('admin'), unchanged. The diff only adds a field to the response body of routes whose authorization was already in place and is not touched here.

droppedAngles.title: security
droppedAngles.why: No injection surface, no secret/token handling, no redirect/CORS/SSRF code, and no new third-party data flow. interestRateBps is a non-secret account attribute the PR explicitly intends members to see on their own accounts (and it was already readable in full via the admin-only POST .../interest-rate response, so no new information is reachable by a new audience).

droppedAngles.title: silent-drops
droppedAngles.why: This diff writes nothing new — interestRateBps was already stored by openAccount/setInterestRate and kept by store.pick() under the existing SCHEMA entry (src/store.js) before this PR. The change is purely read-side (serialize.js exposes an already-persisted field). I manually verified round-trip: set rate via POST, then read via GET /accounts/:id — the exact value comes back, including through a cache entry warmed before the write (tested directly in this worktree, not just via the PR's own test).

scoutNotes: Adds `interestRateBps` to the public account shape in src/serialize.js (publicAccount), so every endpoint that returns an account — GET /accounts, GET /accounts/:id, POST /accounts, POST /accounts/:id/close, POST /deposits, POST /accounts/:id/interest-rate — now includes the rate. Updates README's endpoint table and the HTTP round-trip test's expected key set, and adds one assertion that a member reads back, via GET /accounts/:id, the rate an administrator just set through the existing admin-only route.
